answer: Identity is bound to a physically unclonable delay fingerprint: each device's silicon emits a timing pulse no two chips reproduce. Registration stores it; hourly challenges re-measure it. The mirror ledger publishes the canyon between enrolled and observed distributions, so a cloned fingerprint collapses visibly. A sybil farm must buy distinct silicon per identity and pay continuous attestation power, making each fake agent cost real hardware — cheaper to hire real users than fake them.
